findings.passage: It is Day Three of the 2025-2026 legislative session. Already, Republicans skirted the rules and rushed senators into a senate floor session. Republicans are more afraid of voters and losing power than they are about the issues that are impacting those voters.
findings.note: Press release issued in his name, stating his opposition to 2025 Senate Joint Resolution 2 (the voter ID constitutional amendment) during the Senate floor session. The quoted text objects to how the session was handled and does not discuss ID requirements themselves. Also carried by WEAU (https://www.weau.com/2025/01/08/wisconsin-gop-lawmakers-looking-get-voter-id-laws-state-constitution-by-spring/).
